name: Tatterdemalion
source:
Beth's night goes from bad to bizarre: a car crash lands her in a forest where knights and witches are hunting her. The Tatterwitches guide newcomers from other worlds, but Beth may be the only one without magic.

[From [url=https://bridlewise.itch.io/tatterdemalion]Itch.io[/url]]
